question: Who founded the Brahmo Samaj in Calcutta in 1828?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ram Mohan Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy is known as the **father of the Indian Renaissance** due to his significant contributions to social, religious, and educational reforms in India.
 
• He founded the Brahmo Samaj in 1828 in Calcutta with the aim of reforming and modernizing Indian society by promoting **monotheism and rationalism**.
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy campaigned vigorously against social evils like **sati (the practice of widow immolation)** and child marriage, advocating for the rights of women and other marginalized groups.
 
• He also played a crucial role in the abolition of sati in 1829, collaborating closely with the British government to ensure its eradication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brahmo Samaj**

 
 
• The Brahmo Samaj was one of the earliest socio-religious reform movements in India, aimed at **eradicating social and religious practices** that were considered regressive and superstitious.
 
• It advocated for **the worship of one God** without any rituals or priestly intermediaries, and emphasized the importance of rationality and human dignity.
 
• The Brahmo Samaj also worked towards promoting **education, especially for women**, and campaigned for social reforms such as the abolition of caste discrimination and the promotion of widow remarriage.
 
• It laid the foundation for many future reform movements in India and influenced prominent leaders and thinkers such as Keshab Chandra Sen and Rabindranath Tagore.
 
 
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**
 
 
• Born on May 22, 1772, in Radhanagar, Bengal, Raja Ram Mohan Roy was a polymath who made significant contributions to Indian society through his **work as a social and educational reformer, and his advocacy for human rights**.
 
• He was a proponent of modern scientific knowledge and believed in the importance of English education for the progress of India.
 
• In addition to founding the Brahmo Samaj, he also established the **Atmiya Sabha** (Society of Friends) in 1815 to debate and discuss theological and philosophical issues.
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy was also a prolific writer and published several works in Bengali, Hindi, Persian, and English, addressing various social, political, and religious issues.
